objective: Reject deterministic Minecraft actions when Mineflayer physics state is missing or stale, and return bounded tick/progress/stagnation evidence for every attempted short movement without adding a new capability.
non_goals: Do not add a new skill, target-coordinate navigation, pathfinding, retry, jumping, sprinting, combat, mining, placing or inventory mutation.
Do not let the LLM, chat, vision, memory, viewer input or widget invoke Minecraft actions.
Do not add generated code, eval, shell, arbitrary plugins, telemetry persistence or a new dependency.
Do not treat local unit evidence as a real-server success-rate result.
Do not retrain, replace or benchmark the external Vision provider.
contracts: The Mineflayer boundary exposes only a bounded physics tick sequence and age; raw bot, packets and server content remain hidden.
look.v1 and move.step.v1 fail before emitting an action when no physics tick has been observed or the latest tick is older than 1000 milliseconds.
Controller status reports fresh, stale or unavailable physics state explicitly and never labels an unknown age as zero.
Movement evidence includes bounded physics tick count, current stagnant tick count and maximum observed forward progress for success, blocked, timeout, cancellation and verifier failure.
Blocked movement remains one attempt with no retry or pathfinding, and all control states are still cleared in finally.
External Cloud Vision behavior, model selection and VRAM accounting remain unchanged.
allowed_dependencies: Existing pinned Node.js, Electron, Vue and Mineflayer dependencies only; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter tests prove physics freshness is unavailable before the first tick, fresh after a tick and stale after the fixed age ceiling.
Controller tests prove stale and unavailable state reject look and movement before Mineflayer receives controls.
Movement tests prove success and blocked failure expose bounded tick, stagnation and maximum-progress evidence while always clearing controls.
Desktop Minecraft page explains and renders current physics freshness without exposing network or vendor objects.
Minecraft tests, Desktop typecheck/build/tests, repository fast tests, module-brief validation, GitNexus scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S5-state-freshness-movement-evidence-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
